children.value: > Fact From Story: Ratcliffe is demanding an executive role and overall control of day-to-day football matters and plans to appoint his own sporting director.
> > Fact From Story: Should Ratcliffe come in, talkSPORT understands that he would take charge of footballing matters, something the Glazers have been accused of having little to no interest in.

> > > Fact From Story: Expect Sir Dave Brailsford, the mastermind behind Team GB’s cycling success at the London 2012 Olympics and director of sport for Ratcliffe’s company INEOS, to have a prominent role in any reshuffle.
> > > Fact From Story: Ratcliffe also has ambitious plans to upgrade Old Trafford and turn it into a 90,000-seat stadium.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: An executive role gives a person the authority to make decisions and implement changes.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Generally, the owner of a sports team has control over the sporting matters of the team.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A sporting director is someone who handles the sporting matters of a team.
